patch.summary: Educational nonprofit connecting liberty-minded people with New Hampshire through relocation resources, community connections and events.
patch.description:
The Free State Project describes itself as a 501(c)(3) educational nonprofit. Its work focuses on bringing liberty-minded people to New Hampshire and helping residents and newcomers connect through education, voluntary activity and community-building.

The organization distinguishes its educational role from electoral campaigning: it says it does not run or endorse candidates or endorse legislation. That is a description of FSP, not a claim about every participant or independent group.

Visitors can explore relocation resources, the Free State Forum, the Porcupine Post newsletter, and events such as PorcFest and the New Hampshire Liberty Forum.

Official Facebook, X and YouTube links are listed on FSP’s social-media page. Community Discord and Telegram destinations are linked by FSP; linking does not establish that FSP owns or controls a chat. The original imported chat links are retained, but have not been independently revalidated.

This directory entry is independent of FSP. The contact address is a published mailing contact, not a confirmed walk-in venue.
patch.accessInstructions: Browse the public website and calendar without joining. For questions, use FSP’s public contact form or office phone. Newsletter, forum and chat participation may require registration or acceptance of each service’s rules. A link is not a guarantee of admission. Use the public Discord invitation below rather than assuming an imported internal-channel URL will grant access.
